name: StatsCrew.com
note: Backbone source. Every professional league in American history, one URL pattern, no bot detection. Measured 2026-09-04; see docs/reports/2026-09-04-06-birth-date-coverage-by-league-year.md

person_id_scheme.cross_namespace_evidence: explicit bidirectional link on the page; 35/35 in the cached sample, identical slug body, birth dates agreeing
person_id_scheme.existence_test: a name AND a full birth date must be present; HTTP 200 is NOT existence
traps: p-allengeo002 (player) and c-allengeo001 (coach) are DIFFERENT men - counters do not align
p-allengeo001 returns HTTP 200, is empty, and renders another man's Coach of the Year awards
the slug body is a truncation, so p-brownlar004 is Laron Brown - it groups near-names
the c- namespace holds HEAD COACHES ONLY; assistants are absent entirely

coverage.head_coaches: c- namespace, head-coaching years only (Noll reads 1969-1991, omitting 1960-68 as an assistant)
coverage.assistant_coaches: NONE - Frank Gansz Jr has no record at all

leagues_swept.code_collision: AFL3 resolves to the ARENA Football League, not the 1940 AFL. Do not use it for the third AFL.
leagues_swept.team_codes_globally_unique: VERIFIED across 12 year-sharing league pairs - no team code is reused between leagues in the same year, so a {TEAM}_{YEAR} cache key is safe.

field_availability._comment: Measured, 4 teams per league-year, ~4613 rows. A field below its threshold is not usable as a discriminator for that scope.

birth_date.verdict: usable as primary discriminator in every league-year sampled, 1920 to 2020

_census_all_leagues_2026_09_04.verdict: §9.2 confirmed across every league StatsCrew carries, not just the NFL

jersey._comment: THE era-dependent field. Not a single per-source verdict.
jersey.verdict: NOT usable as a discriminator before ~1935; the 1920 roster page has no jersey column at all
jersey._kind_correction_2026_09_04: Report 06 declared this per_era from a 4-team-per-season sample. The full census of 103 NFL seasons and 117,300 player-rows shows column PRESENCE is also a PER-PAGE property: eight seasons contain teams that lack the column while their contemporaries carry it. It is not an early-era phenomenon - Las Vegas lacks it in 2020.
jersey.no_season_lacks_it_entirely: In NFL 1922-2024 every season has at least one team carrying the column. `column_absent_entirely` applies to APFA-1920 only.

games_played._comment: THE per-league field. Scoping a completeness gate per ERA reads the WFL as catastrophically broken.
games_played.verdict: blank cells are the NORMAL condition in WFL/USFL/XFL - they are absence claims, not defects
games_played._kind_correction_2026_09_04: Declared per_league from report 06's 4-team sample. The full sweep of 34 non-NFL league-seasons shows it swings by season WITHIN a league: WLAF 1991 96.3% -> 1992 16.1%, an 80-point collapse in consecutive seasons of the same league. USFL 1983 86.7% -> 1985 42.0%. UFL games_started 2009 90.2% -> 2012 4.9%. per_league is one level too coarse.

games_started.verdict: CFL and WFL record almost no starts despite CFL recording every game played - per-league, and per-FIELD within a league

_exceptions_found_by_census.note: declared 100.0 for the NFL from an 8-season sample that skipped both years. Two consecutive seasons ~10 points low.

games_started._kind_correction_2026_09_04: Declared per_league from report 06's 4-team sample. The full sweep of 34 non-NFL league-seasons shows it swings by season WITHIN a league: WLAF 1991 96.3% -> 1992 16.1%, an 80-point collapse in consecutive seasons of the same league. USFL 1983 86.7% -> 1985 42.0%. UFL games_started 2009 90.2% -> 2012 4.9%. per_league is one level too coarse.

hometown.verdict: weakest field overall, and worst in the MODERN minor leagues rather than the 1920s - not a reliable fallback discriminator

college.verdict: 100% in every league-year sampled; supports its use as the 1979 same-season discriminator

discriminators.note: source_native_id means the slug, resolved through the cross-reference link and never through a matching string

discriminators.reason: jersey below 90% and absent entirely in 1920
1979 Larry Brown and Gene Washington: position and era both fail inside one season

absence_semantics.column_absent_from_page: not applicable for this era/league - belongs on this declaration, NOT as one absence claim per player
absence_semantics._worked: Akron 1920 has no jersey column (9 headers vs 1950's 10). That is one declaration fact, not 23 identical claims. Matt Brown on the same page has a blank Birth Date in a column that exists - that IS an absence claim.

scores.population: 6 documented collisions + George Allen + Chuck Noll
scores.result: separates every collision tested including 3-generation Clay Matthews

known_conflicts.note: same day and month, four years apart. Presence is not agreement - a denotation must record WHICH source's birth date it matched against.
